lines.speaker: Nina Shah
lines.text: Hi, I'm Nina Shah, and it's my birthday, so you all have to be nice to me. I teach chemistry at East High.

lines.speaker: Laura Bennett
lines.text: I'm Laura Bennett. I'm a graphic designer in Chicago, and I flew in this morning because I've known the birthday girl since college.

lines.speaker: Megan Walsh
lines.text: I'm Megan Walsh. I'm a nurse at Children's Hospital, and I'm in the book club with Nina.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: Chris Porter. I'm Megan's husband, I'm an accountant, and I made the reservation tonight, so you're welcome.

lines.speaker: Emily Hart
lines.text: I'm Emily Hart. I'm a veterinarian in Boulder, and I'm the one who picks the depressing books for book club.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Hey, I'm Sam Torres. I work at REI, and I climb with Owen most Sundays.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: I'm Owen Brooks. I'm a physical therapist, and I'm the one who drove Sam here, because his car is dead again.

lines.speaker: Arjun Mehta
lines.text: I'm Arjun Mehta. I'm a data scientist, and Chris was my college roommate at Colorado State.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: Happy birthday, Nina! Thirty five!

lines.speaker: Nina Shah
lines.text: Thirty four. Do not age me.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: Thirty four. Sorry.

lines.speaker: Emily Hart
lines.text: Laura, how did you and Nina actually meet? I always forget.

lines.speaker: Laura Bennett
lines.text: Freshman orientation at Michigan, August 2008. They put us in the same group for the campus tour, and Nina asked the tour guide so many questions about the chemistry building that the whole group fell twenty minutes behind. I thought she was the most annoying person I had ever met. Then we ended up on the same floor of the dorm, and by October we were inseparable.

lines.speaker: Nina Shah
lines.text: That was 2009, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: Laura Bennett
lines.text: Nina. We graduated in 2012. It was 2008.

lines.speaker: Nina Shah
lines.text: Oh, right, 2008. Okay, I'm already confused and I've only had one drink.

lines.speaker: Megan Walsh
lines.text: And you two lived together after college, right?

lines.speaker: Laura Bennett
lines.text: In Chicago, for six years, until Nina abandoned me for Denver.

lines.speaker: Nina Shah
lines.text: In 2019. And you visit every summer, so stop complaining.

lines.speaker: Arjun Mehta
lines.text: Chris, should I tell them how we met, or will you?

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: Go ahead. You tell it worse than me.

lines.speaker: Arjun Mehta
lines.text: Fall of 2011, Colorado State. Chris and I got randomly assigned as roommates in the same tiny dorm room. The very first night, he set off the smoke alarm making ramen in an electric kettle, and the whole building had to stand outside in the rain at two in the morning. Everyone was furious with him. I decided right there that anybody that bad at cooking needed a friend.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: In my defense, the box said the kettle could do noodles.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Ha, true. He still can't cook.

lines.speaker: Megan Walsh
lines.text: He really can't. I do everything.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: Arjun, you're in the fantasy football league too, right?

lines.speaker: Arjun Mehta
lines.text: The Dynasty League, yes. Me, Chris, Sam, Kevin Doyle, and Matt Fisher. Chris and I started it in 2013.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: 2014. We started it in 2014, the year I got my first real job.

lines.speaker: Arjun Mehta
lines.text: No, it was 2013. I still have the email.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: You do not have the email.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: I joined in 2017, and I've won it twice, so honestly the founding year doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: Arjun Mehta
lines.text: That's the part that hurts the most.

lines.speaker: Emily Hart
lines.text: Wait, Arjun, you're getting married soon, aren't you?

lines.speaker: Arjun Mehta
lines.text: In September! Claire and I are getting married in Napa, at a vineyard. Claire Dunn. She's a pediatric dentist, and you would all love her.

lines.speaker: Megan Walsh
lines.text: We met her at the holiday party. She's lovely.

lines.speaker: Arjun Mehta
lines.text: We met on a hiking app in 2021, which is either very romantic or very sad.

lines.speaker: Laura Bennett
lines.text: Very romantic. Better than how I met my ex.

lines.speaker: Nina Shah
lines.text: Oh no. Are we doing the Sam Reyes story?

lines.speaker: Laura Bennett
lines.text: We are doing the Sam Reyes story. So Sam Reyes and I dated from 2014 to 2017 in Chicago. We met because she rear ended my car at a stoplight on Lake Shore Drive, and instead of exchanging insurance, we went and got coffee. Three years later we broke up, very calmly, like adults, and now she's honestly one of my best friends. She's coming to visit me in April.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Sam Reyes, not me. Just to be clear.

lines.speaker: Laura Bennett
lines.text: Not you, Sam. A different Sam.

lines.speaker: Emily Hart
lines.text: Two Sams. This is going to get confusing.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: Speaking of exes, Hannah says happy birthday, by the way. She's stuck at a work dinner.

lines.speaker: Nina Shah
lines.text: Tell her thank you! How is the wedding planning going?

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: Stressful. She texts me spreadsheets. I don't know why. I'm the ex.

lines.speaker: Megan Walsh
lines.text: Because you're the most organized person she knows.

lines.speaker: Emily Hart
lines.text: Okay, I have to tell you all about Iceland, because I never got to at book club.

lines.speaker: Emily Hart
lines.text: So my college roommate Paige Wilson and I went to Iceland in 2022. We rented this tiny car and drove the whole ring road in ten days. On day four we got a flat tire in the middle of nowhere, with no cell service at all, and this old farmer pulled over on a tractor, changed the tire for us, refused to take any money, and invited us in for lamb soup. Best meal of my entire life.

lines.speaker: Laura Bennett
lines.text: Wasn't that 2021? I remember seeing the photos the summer I changed jobs.

lines.speaker: Emily Hart
lines.text: No, 2022. Paige got married in 2021, so it couldn't have been that year.

lines.speaker: Laura Bennett
lines.text: I really think it was 2021.

lines.speaker: Emily Hart
lines.text: Agree to disagree.

lines.speaker: Nina Shah
lines.text: Paige is in the book club now too, right?

lines.speaker: Megan Walsh
lines.text: She joined Second Chapter last fall. So now it's five of us. Me, Nina, Laura, Emily, and Paige.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Okay. Owen, can I tell the Breckenridge story?

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Too late. So, January 2023, the whole climbing crew goes up to Breckenridge for a ski weekend. Owen, a professional physical therapist, a person who tells other people how to avoid injuries for a living, goes off a tiny little jump on a green run, lands completely flat, and tears his ACL. On a green run.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: It was a blue run.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: It was a green run. There were six year olds on it.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: Okay, fine, it was a green run. And then I had to do my own rehab for eight months, and I was a terrible patient. I yelled at my own exercise bands. Megan had to come over twice a week just to make me do my exercises.

lines.speaker: Megan Walsh
lines.text: He cried at the leg press. I have witnesses.

lines.speaker: Arjun Mehta
lines.text: No way!

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: Okay, everyone, raise a glass. To Nina.

lines.speaker: Laura Bennett
lines.text: To Nina!

lines.speaker: Nina Shah
lines.text: Thank you. Honestly, I'm so lucky. Six years ago I didn't know a single person here.

lines.speaker: Emily Hart
lines.text: Nina, what was your favorite birthday ever?

lines.speaker: Nina Shah
lines.text: Probably my twenty first, in Ann Arbor, in 2012. Laura threw me a surprise party in our tiny apartment and invited like forty people. Then the landlord showed up, and instead of shutting it down, he stayed and danced until two in the morning. I still think about that landlord a lot.

lines.speaker: Laura Bennett
lines.text: Ha, true. He was the best dancer there.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Megan, are you and Chris going to Napa for Arjun's wedding?

lines.speaker: Megan Walsh
lines.text: Yes, we already booked the flights. It's our first trip without the dog.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: I'm a groomsman, so I have to give a speech. I'm terrified.

lines.speaker: Arjun Mehta
lines.text: Do not mention the kettle.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: I am absolutely mentioning the kettle.

lines.speaker: Nina Shah
lines.text: Laura, did Sam ever pay you back for those concert tickets?

lines.speaker: Laura Bennett
lines.text: Not yet. Still waiting.

lines.speaker: Emily Hart
lines.text: Okay, I have to ask. Owen, are you seeing anyone?

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: I am not answering that at a birthday dinner.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: His only relationship right now is with his trivia team.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: The Know It Alls are a serious commitment. We came in second last week.

lines.speaker: Arjun Mehta
lines.text: Who's on that team?

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: Me, my roommates Lucy Ford and Ravi Kapoor, and Ben Carter, Megan's cousin.

lines.speaker: Arjun Mehta
lines.text: Wait. Ravi Kapoor? Ravi is my cousin!

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: No way. Ravi never told me that.

lines.speaker: Arjun Mehta
lines.text: Our moms are sisters. He's coming to the wedding too.

lines.speaker: Megan Walsh
lines.text: Denver is so small.

lines.speaker: Emily Hart
lines.text: Okay, cake time. Nina, make a wish.

lines.speaker: Nina Shah
lines.text: I wish that next year we all do this again. Same table, same people.

lines.speaker: Laura Bennett
lines.text: And that Chris doesn't burn anything.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: One time! One kettle!

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Happy birthday, Nina.

events.name: Nina's twenty first birthday party in Ann Arbor
Arjun and Claire's wedding in Napa
